['Arlanxeo Deutschland GmbH '].company_description: Arlanxeo Deutschland GmbH operates in the production of polybutadiene rubber (PBR), thermoplastic vulcanisates (TPVs), and synthetic rubber solutions for lithium-ion batteries. The company has recently expanded its production capacity in Brazil and is committed to meeting customer demand for reliable rubber in Latin America.

['Saria SE & Co. KG '].company_description: Saria SE & Co. KG is a German agriculture group that is involved in converting animal origin and other organic materials into valuable inputs for new purposes. It operates globally and is known for its contribution to the circular economy. Additionally, Saria SE & Co. KG completed the acquisition of Devro plc, a leading supplier of collagen-based films and coatings for food, which is used in the production of sausages and other meat products.
